content.title: WHY YOUR BODY IS BEGGING YOU FOR THESE {{MINERALS}}
facts: **Potassium** (Heart Rhythm Keeper) — Coconut Water | White Beans | Bananas | Swiss Chard
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Pineapple | Brown Rice | Hazelnuts
**Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Seaweed | Cod | Greek Yogurt | Eggs
**Copper** (Energy Spark) — Beef Liver | Cashews | Lentils | Dark Leafy Greens
**Zinc** (Immune Shield) — Oysters | Chickpeas | Pumpkin Hummus | Beef
**Selenium** (Cell Protector) — Brazil Nuts (1-2/day) | Tuna | Eggs | Sunflower Seeds
**Chromium** (Blood Sugar Balancer) — Broccoli | Grapes | Barley | Turkey Breast
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Most people have never even heard of chromium, but it plays a quiet role in helping your cells respond to insulin, which is why blood sugar swings can feel less brutal when you're getting enough of it. Potassium works almost like an electrical regulator for your heart — it helps trigger the signal that keeps your heartbeat steady, which is why a deficiency can literally feel like your chest is fluttering for no reason. And copper isn't just a trace mineral hiding in the background — it helps your body actually use the iron you eat, so even with enough iron intake, low copper can still leave you feeling drained. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and adjust from there.
